title: ATP Protocol Conflict Rule
description: Explicit resolution rule for when two protocols both match the same input above threshold.

resolution.description: priority=higher priority field wins. specificity=more specific trigger match wins. manual=this rule defines the winner explicitly.

winner.description: Must equal the value of protocol_a or protocol_b. Validators must enforce this constraint programmatically (JSON Schema draft-07 does not support cross-field equality natively).

context_conditions.description: Optional: additional context conditions under which this rule applies. If empty, rule applies unconditionally.

rationale.description: Human-readable explanation of why this resolution was chosen
